verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents its own process to upload equity promises in bulk, which is a first-party batch-entry capability close to the story. However, the evidence covers only promises, not batch issuance of actual grants or bulk import of historical transactions; Gusto sync and predefined vesting schedules reduce re-entry but are adjacent features. Missing for 10: documented bulk grant issuance, bulk import of historical transactions or cap-table records, details of the bulk upload format and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time

citations.quote: For multiple promises, there is a process to upload equity promises in bulk.
